description: The line plot illustrates the Word Error Rate (WER) during the fine-tuning of the Whisper “tiny” model across six epochs, comparing five different weight quantization and adaptation strategies: “tiny AdaLoRA_int4”, “tiny AdaLoRA_int8”, “tiny int4”, “tiny int8”, and “tiny full”. The x-axis, labeled “epoch”, spans from 0 to 6 with integer tick marks at each epoch. The y-axis, labeled “WER”, ranges from 25 to 70 with major gridlines and tick labels every 5 units. The “tiny AdaLoRA_int4” line (gray with circle markers, solid line) starts at approximately 69 WER at epoch 0 and decreases steadily to about 40 by epoch 6. The “tiny AdaLoRA_int8” line (gray with square markers, solid line) begins at 60, drops to around 51 by epoch 1, then gradually declines to 37 by epoch 6. The “tiny int4” line (gray with circle markers, dashed line) starts at 69, falls to 55 at epoch 1, and continues to decrease to 40 by epoch 6. The “tiny int8” line (gray with square markers, dashed line) begins at 60, drops to 47 at epoch 1, and ends at 36 by epoch 6. The “tiny full” line (gray with triangle markers, dotted line) starts at 29, dips slightly to 27 by epoch 1, remains relatively flat until epoch 3, then drops to 24 by epoch 6, showing the lowest and most stable WER across all methods.
